ShortDescription.Value: Import OpenStreetMap data and generate roads into Cities Skylines 2

Publish.LongDescription:
**NOTE:** This mod is a work in progress! The roads (especially roads that are elevated) are generating incorrectly.
A **Cities: Skylines 2** mod that imports real-world road network data from **[OpenStreetMap](https://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/About_OpenStreetMap) (OSM)** XML files and procedurally generates the corresponding road networks inside the game world.
## Usage ### 1. Dowload OSM Data OSM data can be downloaded from a variety of sources. \ I recommend you download OSM from [terraining.ateliernonta.com](https://terraining.ateliernonta.com) (more detailed instructions at the [GitHub repo](https://github.com/nonta1234/terraining-heightmap-generator#readme)).
#### Note It is recommended that you also download heightmap data at the website [terraining.ateliernonta.com](https://terraining.ateliernonta.com).
[Learn more about heightmaps in Cities Skylines II](https://cs2.paradoxwikis.com/Map_Creation#Heightmaps)
### 2. Launch editor This mod was built to work with the in-game editor mode.
### 3. Open OSM Importer Tool
You can open the OSM Importer tool panel by clicking on the button ... ***TODO ! ! ! FINISH ! ! ! TODO***
### 4. Import the OSM Data Using the OSM Importer tool panel, input the path to the OSM data file from step 1 and import the data.
#### Note The import process will take some time and likely freeze your game for 10+ seconds.
### 5. Generate roads Wait patiently while roads generate and enjoy! Once you've imported the data, you can select different subsets of the roads to generate.
#### Note Be aware the road generation can take some time. \ Areas with lots of roads will require a lot of compute power.
